description: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird announced Wednesday that she is suing surveillance video company ADI Global Distribution Inc. The suit says ADI hid that the cameras manufacturers, Hikvision and Dahua, have close ties to the Chinese military. The suit says both camera makers are on a list of foreign entities that pose a national security risk to the United States.…
